title: 011 · Tracking stuck after depot arrival
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Mera Olt. From the case card: tracking for DL-011 stopped at the arrival scan, so the depot must locate the actual parcel rather than repeat the public tracking status.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the depot to physically locate the parcel and provide a fresh scan with its location.

recipient.name: Mera Olt
recipient.responsibility: Raise the question of whether the parcel is actually at the depot.

tracking_support.name: Tracking support
tracking_support.responsibility: Report what the tracking system shows for the shipment.

depot.name: Destination depot
depot.responsibility: Physically locate the parcel and provide a new scan with its storage position.

goal: Get the destination depot to physically locate DL-011 and provide a fresh scan with its verified location.
limits: Do not present a physical depot scan as proof of dispatch or delivery.

intake.summary: DL-011: tracking has not updated after the depot arrival scan; the actual parcel needs to be located.
intake.note: Creation time is taken from the case card. The history has no separate system event for ticket creation.

initial.blocker: Tracking stopped at the arrival scan; the parcel's actual location is not confirmed.

facts.text: Tracking stopped at the arrival scan.

steps.label: Depot scan
steps.title: Depot finds DL-011 in cage C-17
steps.explanation: The depot found the parcel, scanned the label and the new location scan is visible, so the coordination task can be closed. The parcel has not been allocated to a van, so delivery remains open.

facts_upsert.text: The depot verified the storage position: sort cage C-17.

The new location scan is now visible.
DL-011 has not been allocated to a van yet.
